messages:
Jordan (Finance Ops): Heads up — VoltAI's March invoice 987654 has a reserved capacity line but their early-termination credit wasn't applied. Can we do a manual proration credit?
Evan (Account Manager): Ack. I'm on it. They terminated their Dedicated pool mid-cycle (effective 2026-03-05). Contract contains a pro‑rata refund clause.
Jordan (Finance Ops): Copy. Here's the invoice snippet we pulled: ```
Invoice: 987654
Customer: VoltAI
Period: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31
Line: Reserved GPUs (reserved-01) — $5,000.00
Line: Usage (on-demand) — $320.00
Total due: $5,320.00
Applied credits: none
Requested manual credit (pro‑rata): ~$4,280.00
```
Priya (Head of Billing): Need the exact math and a supporting signed termination/TOA from legal. Who calculated the $4,280 number?
Evan (Account Manager): Calculation from AM: monthly reserved fee $5,000. Termination effective 3/5 => unused days = 26 of 31. 26/31 * 5000 = $4,193.55. We rounded to $4,280 to cover rounding + quick goodwill for CS. Signed termination email was received from VoltAI PM on 2026-03-06 (I'll drop the thread link in the ticket).
Jordan (Finance Ops): billing-bot, can you draft a credit memo for this? Tag it voltai-termination-2026 and set reason = "pro‑rata reserved capacity refund + goodwill rounding"
billing-bot: Draft created — CM-2026-412 for $4,280.00 (status: DRAFT). Attachments: none.
Priya (Head of Billing): Approve up to $5k for termination prorates without exec signoff. Evan — upload the signed termination email and the calc (spreadsheet) to the credit memo record and confirm tax treatment (is this taxable in their jurisdiction?).
Evan (Account Manager): Uploaded: termination_email_voltai_20260306.eml, calc_987654.xlsx. Tax: VoltAI is US-based (NY); refund is non-taxable adjustment per our tax counsel.
Jordan (Finance Ops): Great. billing-bot, move CM-2026-412 to PENDING_APPROVAL.
billing-bot: CM-2026-412 status updated -> PENDING_APPROVAL (requested approver: Priya).
Priya (Head of Billing): Approving. Please note: include a short memo in the invoice thread: "Approved per clause 6.2; AM confirmed termination email on 2026-03-06."
Jordan (Finance Ops): Approved and memo added. billing-bot, finalize and post credit against invoice 987654.
billing-bot: CM-2026-412 moved to APPROVED and applied to Invoice 987654. New invoice balance: $0.00. Journal: CRD-2026-412 applied, revenue impact flagged for RevOps.
Evan (Account Manager): Customer notified via support ticket — they replied: "Thanks for handling this so quickly, appreciate it." :relieved:
Jordan (Finance Ops): Evan — please close the support ticket and mark the account as terminated in billing. I'll file the credit memo paperwork to the month-end bundle.
Evan (Account Manager): Will do. Closing ticket now.
Jordan (Finance Ops): Thanks all :thumbsup:
